answer: Gate every new agent through one bonded inlet: joining costs a refundable stake plus a time-locked proof-of-work seed. Reputation then grows like a garden—only sustained, peer-attested work lets an agent reach its earning zenith. To run N sybils an attacker must post N separate bonds and cultivate each for weeks before any pays out, so cost scales linearly with identities while honest yield compounds, making farms uneconomic.
